thread:
Alex: @here PR #64422 is ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/64422 — it updates allocator routing to add a fallback route and a heuristic for weights. Need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes before we merge this week. Canary proposal: 2026-03-19 08:00-10:00 PT. Can someone own approvals and merge timing?

Jordan: I can take platform eyes. Quick Q: what's the expected perf hit? Any config toggles that need prod changes?

Priya: I can do runtime perf checks. Do you have CI perf runs or flamegraphs? Also does this touch kernel selection / batching codepaths?

Alex: Perf runs linked: http://ci.internal/runs/2211 — p50 unchanged, p95 ~ +2ms, p99 ~ +5ms. It only adjusts routing weights and eviction ordering, not kernel selection. Config example to flip during canary: ```
flags:
  route_fallback: true
  fallback_weight: 0.2
```

Diego: I'll scope infra impact. Any KMS changes or new IAM roles? Any persistence migration?

Alex: No KMS or schema changes. No new IAM. It's a runtime/orch config flip + a small runtime rollout. We'll add the flag to the orch config during canary.

Mira: Security quick check: does fallback routing change tenant isolation or cross-tenant request paths? Please add a short note to the PR describing tenant-scoping and data-path guarantees so I can sign off.

Alex: Added a security note and linked the threat-model doc: https://confluence/redwood/security/fallback-routing. Also added a short runbook stub and unit test.

Priya: LGTM from runtime side pending canary observation. I'll monitor latency, KV hit-rate and memory pressure. Ping me when canary starts.

Jordan: Platform pending infra check but looks fine so far — will wait on Diego's OK.

Diego: Infra: no blocker from infra. No network/IAM changes. I'll be on-call for the canary window.

Alex: Sweet. Assigning roles: Priya = canary steward, Jordan = merge steward, Diego = infra on-call, Mira = security post-canary signoff. @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary window 2026-03-19T08:00-10:00 PT?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-19 08:00-10:00 PT. Reminder set. Ticket CN-883 created.

Priya: I'll add a short healthcheck in the runbook: `curl -sS $STAGING/health | jq .kv_hit_rate` and watch for kv_hit_rate drop > 10%.

Aria: Quick bump — plan to merge after green canary. @Jordan if canary is green can you merge Friday morning?

Jordan: Yes, I can merge after canary signoff on Friday.

Alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: — I'll squash-and-merge once we have green signals and Jordan gives the final thumbs.
